+class _Urllib3Response(object):
+    def __init__(self, response):
+        self.status_code = response.status
+        self.reason = getattr(response, 'reason', '')
+        self.headers = dict(response.headers)
+        self.content = response.data if response.data is not None else b''
+
+    def json(self):
+        content = self.content.decode('utf-8') if isinstance(self.content, bytes) else self.content
+        return loads(content)

+class _Urllib3Session(object):
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._pool = urllib3.PoolManager()
+        self.auth = None
+        self.headers = {}
+
+    def request(self, method, url, data=None, timeout=None, headers=None):
+        request_headers = dict(self.headers)
+        if headers:
+            request_headers.update(headers)
+
+        if self.auth and isinstance(self.auth, tuple) and len(self.auth) == 2:
+            token = base64.b64encode(("%s:%s" % self.auth).encode('utf-8')).decode('ascii')
+            request_headers.setdefault('Authorization', 'Basic %s' % token)
+
+        body = data
+        if isinstance(body, dict):
+            content_type = request_headers.get('Content-Type', '')
+            if content_type.startswith('application/x-www-form-urlencoded'):
+                body = urlencode(body)
+            elif content_type.startswith('application/json') or not content_type:
+                body = dumps(body)
+                request_headers.setdefault('Content-Type', 'application/json')
+            else:
+                body = urlencode(body)
+
+        response = self._pool.request(method, url, body=body, headers=request_headers, timeout=timeout)
+        return _Urllib3Response(response)
